info.title: Brim Sentinel API
info.description: Detect. Resolve. Settle. Explain. — AP automation and payment controls for Harborline Logistics (synthetic). All payments are SIMULATED. Demo identities (X-Demo-User-Id) are a labelled simulation, not authentication.

patch.description: Authorized edit → new immutable version; prior approvals invalidated; full revalidation.

post.description: Authorized, reasoned false-positive dismissal. Hard holds are not dismissible.
Record an approval/rejection bound to the current invoice version. Never releases payment.

schema.title: Response List Payments Api V1 Payments Get

post.description: Schedule a SIMULATED payment for an approved invoice (AP clerk prepares; P09).

Independent authorized release of a SIMULATED payment. All gates re-checked in one write
transaction. Same Idempotency-Key + same body → original result; different body → 409.
Record a SIMULATED settlement outcome. No funds move.

Human case actions. `request_information` returns a DRAFT message only (a person sends it).
`document_decision` (controller/CFO) can reject or keep on hold — there is no release override.
Wizard step 2: record an independent callback to a trusted contact already on file.

Wizard step 3: finance manager/controller (not the verifier) authorizes the verified route;
affected invoices are revalidated deterministically.
Wizard step 4: request approvals. This is NOT an approval or a release.

Bounded read-only investigation (≤ 8 allowlisted lookups, masked data, cited output).
AI is off by default → deterministic template. Never changes holds, cases or approvals.

schema.title: Response List Vendors Api V1 Vendors Get

post.description: Onboarding request → vendor in pending_review (held). Activation is a separate person.

Record a bank-change REQUEST. The vendor master is not changed and the new route is
UNVERIFIED; open invoices for the vendor are revalidated (and held).

get.description: Read-only. There is no endpoint that modifies or deletes audit events.
